title: A Room for the Visitor
author: Beatrix Oyelaran
blurb: Jude Ishikawa, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
